prediction.likelyOutcome: LBJ Venture will almost certainly recover the conceded $96,072.49 (net unpaid rent, late fees, prejudgment interest) plus a fee award somewhere between $35,000 and $67,000. The acceleration claim is unlikely to survive because section 10.02(b) contains no express acceleration language and expressly conditions lump-sum recovery on the landlord NOT reletting — which it did — and the $300,000 kitchen claim likely fails outright because the landlord's own witness could not value the kitchen at lease end or quantify any enhancement to the premises.

issues.label: Acceleration of Full Remaining Ten-Year Rent

outcome.description: After the bench trial the trial court rendered judgment for the landlord of $96,072.49 (unpaid rent through trial net of replacement-tenant rent, late fees, and prejudgment interest) — the figure the tenant advocated, roughly one-tenth of the more than $900,000 the landlord sought — plus 18% post-judgment interest, and awarded $0 in attorneys' fees. The court of appeals affirmed the damages award and reversed only the denial of attorneys' fees, remanding for a determination of a reasonable fee under the lease.
outcome.finalNote: Damages affirmed; fee denial reversed and remanded.
